question: What is the ABB order code for the AC500-eCo PM554-TP-ETH CPU with integrated Ethernet?
expected_answer: The PM554-TP-ETH (24 V DC, transistor outputs, integrated Ethernet) has order code 1SAP120600R0071.

question: What tightening torque is specified for the 5069-RTB4-SCREW and 5069-RTB6-SCREW removable terminal blocks used with CompactLogix 5380 controllers?
expected_answer: The screw-type RTBs must be torqued to 0.4 N-m (3.5 lb-in); torque does not apply to the spring-type RTBs.

question: What is the operating temperature range of the Allen-Bradley MicroLogix 1100 controller?
expected_answer: The MicroLogix 1100 operates from -20 degC to +65 degC (-4 degF to +149 degF).

question: How many axes of high-speed pulse output does the Delta DVP-EH3 PLC provide, and at what frequency?
expected_answer: The DVP-EH3 provides 4 axes of 200 kHz high-speed pulse output (on DVP40/48/64/80EH00T3 models).

question: What is the LD/MOV instruction execution speed of the Mitsubishi MELSEC iQ-F FX5U PLC?
expected_answer: The FX5U executes LD/MOV instructions in 34 ns, with a program capacity of 64k steps.

question: What is the program memory capacity of the Omron CP1L-EM CPU units?
expected_answer: CP1L-EM CPU units have a memory capacity of 10K steps (CP1L-L units have 5K steps).

question: What ingress protection rating do the Advantech WebOP-2000 series operator panels carry?
expected_answer: All WebOP-2000 series models support NEMA 4 / IP65 waterproof protection and 0-50 degC operating temperatures.

question: To what torque should the mounting clip screws be tightened when panel-mounting a PanelView 5510 stainless steel terminal?
expected_answer: The mounting clip screws must be torqued to 2.3-2.6 N-m (20-23 lb-in) using the specified sequence, repeating until all clips hold the torque.

question: What is the permissible power supply voltage range of the Beijer X2 pro 4 (B2) HMI panel?
expected_answer: The X2 pro 4 - B2 runs on +24 VDC nominal with an allowed range of 18-32 V DC (Class 2 supply for UL/cUL).

question: What is the power supply voltage specification for the Mitsubishi GOT2000 GT25 wide models such as the GT2512-WXTBD?
expected_answer: GT25 wide models are rated DC24V with a tolerance of +25%/-20%; GT2512 maximum-load power consumption is 20 W or less.

question: What is the rated power supply voltage of the Omron NB-series programmable terminals?
expected_answer: The NB series is rated DC24V +/-15% (i.e. 20.4-27.6 V DC).

question: What supply voltage and typical power draw does the Red Lion G315C operator interface require?
expected_answer: The G315C requires +24 VDC +/-20% from a Class 2/SELV supply, drawing 27 W typical and 67 W maximum.

question: In the ABB ACS880 IGBT supply control program, which relay outputs control the main contactor and the charging contactor by default?
expected_answer: By default the control program drives the main contactor with relay output RO3 and the charging contactor/relay with relay output RO1.

question: What output frequency range does the Danfoss VLT Micro Drive FC 51 provide?
expected_answer: The FC 51 outputs 0-200 Hz in VVC+ mode and 0-400 Hz in u/f mode.

question: What is the estimated lifespan of the cooling fan in a Mitsubishi FR-E800 inverter?
expected_answer: The cooling fan has an estimated lifespan of 10 years, assuming a yearly average surrounding air temperature of 40 degC (30 degC for the FR-E806).

question: What is the factory-set switching frequency of the Schneider Electric Altivar ATV320 drive?
expected_answer: The ATV320 [Switching frequency] SFR parameter is factory set to 4 kHz.

question: What line supply voltage ranges are SINAMICS S120 chassis format power units designed for?
expected_answer: They accept 3-phase 380 V AC -10% (-15% for under 1 min) up to 480 V AC +10%, or 3-phase 500 V AC -10% up to 690 V AC +10%.

question: What is the maximum output frequency of the Yaskawa GA500 drive when controlling an induction motor?
expected_answer: The GA500 reaches a maximum output frequency of 590 Hz for induction motors (also 590 Hz for PM vector control; 270 Hz in advanced PM vector control), with 0.001 Hz output frequency resolution.

question: How much memory does the PM891 processor unit of the ABB AC 800M controller have?
expected_answer: The PM891 has 16 MBytes of flash PROM (firmware storage) and 256 MBytes of DDR2 SDRAM with integrity check.

question: What is the user memory capacity of the Emerson DeltaV SX controller?
expected_answer: The DeltaV SX controller has 96 MB of user memory.

question: How much memory does the Emerson Ovation OCR1100 controller have?
expected_answer: The Ovation OCR1100 controller has 1 GB Flash and 256 MB RAM, with a 1.1 GHz processor base frequency.

question: What processor does the Honeywell ControlEdge PLC Control Processor Module use?
expected_answer: The ControlEdge PLC CPM uses a dual-core ARM Cortex-A9 32-bit processor running at 667 MHz.

question: How many Series 8 I/O modules can an Experion LX C300 controller support?
expected_answer: The C300 supports 80 I/O units (redundant or non-redundant IOMs) per controller, with 40 I/O units per I/O Link across its 2 I/O Links.

question: What is the base accuracy of the ABB 266MST differential pressure transmitter?
expected_answer: Base accuracy is 0.04 % of calibrated span, with an optional 0.025 % variant.

question: What is the operating frequency of the Endress+Hauser Micropilot FMR63B free-space radar level transmitter?
expected_answer: The FMR63B operates at approximately 80 GHz, with a maximum emitted peak power of <1.5 mW and an average power output of <70 uW.

question: What nominal diameter range is the Endress+Hauser Proline Promag W 400 electromagnetic flowmeter available in?
expected_answer: The Promag W sensor covers a nominal diameter range of DN 25 to 3000 mm (1 to 120 in).

question: What is the maximum measuring distance of the KROHNE OPTIWAVE 1560 radar level transmitter?
expected_answer: The OPTIWAVE 1560 lens antenna measures distances up to 30 m (98.4 ft), with an accuracy of +/-2 mm (+/-0.08 in).

question: What is the reference accuracy of the Yokogawa EJA110E differential pressure transmitter with the M capsule?
expected_answer: Reference accuracy is +/-0.055 % of span for spans down to 5 kPa (20 inH2O); for smaller spans it is +/-(0.005+0.0025 URL/span) % of span.

question: What power connector types are used on the Allen-Bradley 1732E ArmorBlock 16-channel configurable digital modules?
expected_answer: The 1732E-16CFGM12M12LDR uses M12 L-coded power connectors, while the 1732E-16CFGM12P5DR uses 7/8-inch power connectors. I/O uses M12 A-coded and the EtherNet/IP network uses M12 D-coded connectors.

question: What PROFINET conformance class does the Murrelektronik MVK Fusion fieldbus module support?
expected_answer: The MVK Fusion supports PROFINET specification V2.3, Conformance Class C (IRT), Netload Class III.

question: How many Axioline F devices can be connected to the Phoenix Contact AXL F BK PN PROFINET bus coupler?
expected_answer: Up to 63 Axioline F devices can be connected per station via the AXL F BK PN bus coupler.

question: What is the output current per channel of the Siemens ET 200eco PN DIQ 16x24VDC/0.5A/2A M12-L digital I/O module?
expected_answer: Outputs on sockets X10 to X13 deliver 0.5 A per output (max 2 A total for the group); outputs on X14 to X17 deliver 2 A per output (max 6 A total for the group).

question: What CPU does the WAGO PFC200 G2 controller 750-8212 use?
expected_answer: The 750-8212 PFC200 G2 uses a Cortex A8 CPU running at 1 GHz under real-time Linux 4.9.47-rt37 with RT preemption patch.

question: Up to what welding current is the Balluff BMF 415 weld field immune magnetic field sensor unaffected?
expected_answer: Welding currents up to 110 kA have no effect on the BMF 415 sensor function; its cables are weld spark resistant.

question: What is the measuring range of the ifm O5D100 photoelectric distance sensor?
expected_answer: The ifm O5D100 has a measuring range of 0.03 to 2 m (time-of-flight measurement), with a sampling rate of 33 Hz.

question: What is the maximum switching frequency of the Leuze PRK3CT retro-reflective photoelectric sensor?
expected_answer: The Leuze PRK3CT has a switching frequency of 1,500 Hz, with a response time of 0.33 ms.

question: What is the maximum sensing range of the SICK PowerProx Distance MultiTask photoelectric sensor?
expected_answer: The PowerProx Distance has a maximum sensing range of 50 mm to 3,800 mm (up to 3.8 m) for objects with 6...90 % remission.

question: What is the switching bandwidth of the Advantech EKI-5729PI industrial PoE switch?
expected_answer: The EKI-5729PI has a switching bandwidth of 20 Gbps (the EKI-5624PI has 4.8 Gbps).

question: What is the nominal supply voltage range of the Hirschmann EAGLE40 industrial firewall?
expected_answer: The EAGLE40 has a nominal supply voltage range of 24 V DC to 48 V DC (20...58 V DC including maximum tolerances for EAGLE40-03, 20...54 V DC for EAGLE40-07), with two redundant SELV voltage inputs.

question: What DC input voltage range does the Moxa AWK-4252A wireless AP/bridge/client accept?
expected_answer: The AWK-4252A accepts 12 to 48 VDC on redundant dual power inputs (2.2-0.55 A) and can alternatively be powered via 48 VDC Power-over-Ethernet.

question: What is the permitted voltage range of the 24 VDC power supply input on the Siemens SCALANCE XR524-8C?
expected_answer: The 2 x 24 VDC supply of the SCALANCE XR524-8C has a rated voltage of 24 V DC with a permitted voltage range of 19.2 VDC to 28.8 VDC (fusing 3.15 A / 125 V, current consumption 1 A).

question: What safety rating does the guard locking safety function achieve in the Allen-Bradley 440C-CR30 Cat 1 stop with guardlocking interlock (TLS-ZR) example application?
expected_answer: The guard locking safety function meets SIL CL2 / SIL 2 (per IEC 62061 and IEC 61508) with a Category 3 structure usable up to Performance Level PLd per ISO 13849-1, executing a Stop Category 1.

question: What is the maximum locking force of the Euchner CTP transponder-coded safety switch?
expected_answer: The CTP has a maximum locking force Fmax of 3,900 N; the locking force FZh per EN ISO 14119 is Fmax/1.3 = 3,000 N.

question: What is the limiting continuous current of the safe digital outputs (O1-O4) on the Phoenix Contact PSR-M-B3-XC-SDI8-SDO4-DO4-PI safety module?
expected_answer: Each safe digital output channel is limited to 400 mA continuous current, with a total current of 1.6 A across all four safe digital outputs.

question: What safety characteristic data does the Pilz PNOZ m B1 base unit achieve in 2-channel operating mode?
expected_answer: In 2-channel mode the PNOZ m B1 achieves PL e / Cat. 4 per EN ISO 13849-1 and SIL CL 3 per EN IEC 62061 with PFHD = 4.19E-10 1/h and a mission time TM of 20 years.

question: What is the field of view aperture angle of the SICK safeVisionary2 safe 3D camera?
expected_answer: The safeVisionary2 field of view is 68 deg x 58 deg (horizontal x vertical); for protective field evaluation it is limited to 68 deg x 42 deg.

question: Which device has the shorter minimum IO-Link cycle time: the Banner K50 Pro indicator or the Leuze PRK3CT retro-reflective sensor?
expected_answer: The Leuze PRK3CT is faster with a minimum IO-Link cycle time of 2.3 ms, versus 5 ms for the Banner K50 Pro.

question: Do the Hirschmann EAGLE40 firewall and the Phoenix Contact FL SWITCH 2000 ship with the same default password?
expected_answer: Yes — both ship with the default password 'private' (FL SWITCH 2000 with user name 'admin'; the EAGLE40 forces a password change at first login on HiSecOS 3.4 and later).

question: Which Honeywell controller has more program memory: the Experion LX C300 or the ControlEdge PLC Control Processor Module?
expected_answer: The Experion LX C300 has 16 MB of program memory, versus 10 MB of user programming memory (5 MB program + 5 MB data) on the ControlEdge PLC CPM.

question: Which radar level transmitter offers the longer maximum measuring range: the Siemens SITRANS LR560 or the KROHNE OPTIWAVE 1560?
expected_answer: The SITRANS LR560, which is available in 40 m and 100 m versions, versus a maximum of 30 m for the OPTIWAVE 1560.
